items.title: 大模型学习地铁图：从 Transformer 到今天的主流大模型
items.title_zh: 大模型学习地铁图：从 Transformer 到今天的主流大模型
items.summary: 苦于大模型学习杂乱无章、知识碎片化？这份教程把大模型知识体系设计成地铁图，用一条主干线按技术演进梳理从Transformer到推理模型的核心脉络，还有五条支线按需选择深耕方向。非常适合大模型入门学习者搭建完整知识框架。

items.summary: Sometimes, giving an AI agent all of the knowledge it needs is the wrong approach. At Meta, we’ve seen notable improvements in efficiency and accuracy by keeping the orchestration layer of our data pipeline agents deliberately thin: It routes work and enforces reliability checks…
